$comment: Maximal valid Task Mode rules object. This schema is the thinnest of the five, which is exactly why a positive fixture matters: a schema that rejected everything would have passed every check in this repository before this directory existed.

assignment._note: both assignment and completion are boolean-only objects; the fixture sets them explicitly rather than relying on absence.

completion._note: boolean-only object, set explicitly rather than relying on absence.

commitment._note: the SATISFIED case of the designated_role arm.

x-com.example.gov._note: a top-level vendor-extension key (RFC-MACP-0012 §4; issue #185 S1). Its value is a JSON object the standard schema leaves opaque; this proves the x- arm accepts.
